svg.aria-label: Security controls as a path of five checks, from the internet at the top to the data and services at the bottom. Anything from outside has to pass every check, top to bottom. 1. Physical: Four cameras watch the house and record to a recorder in the rack. Controls: Surveillance (PoE cameras · NVR). 2. Perimeter: Stops and inspects anything coming from the internet. Controls: Firewall and IDS, No open doors (OPNsense firewall · Suricata IDS · no port forwards). 3. Network: Keeps each kind of device on its own separate network. Controls: Separate VLANs, Guest Wi-Fi, Cameras, Storage (6 VLANs · Guest-Internet, IP-Cameras and NAS access lists). 4. Access: Decides who can sign in and who can change settings. Controls: Admin-only logins, Central accounts (Admin-SSH access list · Active Directory · CA · NPS). 5. Data protection: Keeps systems updated, watched, backed up and private. Controls: Updates, Monitoring, Backups, Safe to share (WSUS · Wazuh · Splunk · LibreNMS · UNAS Pro).
svg.title: Security controls
